changes: Fixed table rows with several tall cells being cut off at a page break.
Fixed page breaks cutting off nested lists and tall table rows.
Fixed blank lines from comment-only lines inside a paragraph.
Fixed blank lines left behind by comment-only lines.
Added release notes on the GitHub release page.
Fixed release notes that read as sentences.
Fixed make the commit check and the generator agree on what is readable.
Fixed fail the changelog generator loudly instead of guessing.
Added release notes after an update.
Fixed keep markdown table column alignment in headers.
Added pre-fill the save dialog with the note's folder and name.
Added a configurable table border color.
Fixed the font weight applied to H2 headings.
Removed the automatic uppercase styling from H4 headings.
Added a bold text color setting.
Added a button to reset a preset's colors back to their defaults.
Added a {{title}} placeholder to the page number format.
Added a dropdown menu to the print and export button.
Added a dedicated code font and a ligature toggle. Ligatures are now off by default.
Fixed a crash in the preview and export when a stylesheet came from another window.
